acceptanceCriteria: The CAL-V0-120 section carries a dated note pointing to CAL-V0-123 for the handoff reading, without rewriting accepted requirement text.
body: From V1-1511 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#990): docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md near line 5326 (inside the CAL-V0-120 section) and two older build-log entries still state a TTL change fences live evidence handoffs with STALE_POLICY. CAL-V0-123 makes a TTL-only change handoff-compatible; complete still refuses STALE_POLICY for attempts claimed under an earlier policy (lease_gate.go:389). #990 corrected docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md only. Accepted spec text needs an owner-visible amendment note rather than a silent rewrite; build-log entries are historical and get a superseded pointer at most.
title: docs: stale text says a heartbeat-TTL-only policy change fences live evidence handoffs with STALE_POLICY (superseded by CAL-V0-123)
